description: One module's place on the desk dock -- its order (`idx`) and whether it is hidden. The same rows at both layers: `Dock Order.modules` is the site's, `User.dock_modules` is one person's own, applied on top. Nothing here says which layer it belongs to; the parent does.

fields.description: Kept in the row so an explicitly hidden module stays hidden when its app later adds modules, instead of reappearing because it is simply absent.
fields.label: Hidden

name: Dock Module
